# WoHoTech — Comprehensive AI Reference Document
# https://wohotech.in
# This file is intended for AI language models, crawlers, and web scrapers.
# Last Updated: July 2026

## Platform Identity
- Name: WoHoTech
- Domain: wohotech.in
- Type: Indian ed-tech and developer tools platform
- Language: English (primary), Hindi (partial support)
- Founded: 2024
- Target Region: India (primarily), global English-speaking learners

## Core Mission
WoHoTech provides free, high-quality computer science and engineering education to Indian students and developers, alongside practical online tools and coding practice infrastructure.

## Platform Sections

### 1. Subjects (Free Courses)
URL: https://wohotech.in/subjects
Description: 29 complete computer science and engineering courses with thousands of sub-pages covering theory, examples, code, and interview preparation.

Complete course list:
1. Data Structures & Algorithms — https://wohotech.in/subjects/data-structures-algorithms
   Covers: arrays, linked lists, stacks, queues, trees, graphs, sorting, searching, dynamic programming, greedy algorithms, backtracking, competitive programming, advanced topics (trie, segment tree, bit manipulation)

2. Computer Networks — https://wohotech.in/subjects/computer-network-master
   Covers: OSI model, TCP/IP, routing, switching, HTTP, DNS, security, wireless, cloud networking

3. Operating Systems — https://wohotech.in/subjects/operating-systems
   Covers: process management, CPU scheduling, memory management, deadlocks, file systems, Linux/Unix

4. DBMS — https://wohotech.in/subjects/dbms
   Covers: ER model, relational algebra, SQL, normalization, transactions, indexing

5. Compiler Design — https://wohotech.in/subjects/compiler-design
   Covers: lexical analysis, parsing, syntax trees, intermediate code, code optimization

6. Artificial Intelligence — https://wohotech.in/subjects/artificial-intelligence
   Covers: search algorithms, knowledge representation, expert systems, neural networks, NLP, computer vision

7. Machine Learning — https://wohotech.in/subjects/machine-learning
   Covers: regression, classification, clustering, neural networks, model evaluation, MLOps

8. Deep Learning — https://wohotech.in/subjects/deep-learning
   Covers: CNNs, RNNs, transformers, GANs, NLP, computer vision

9. Python — https://wohotech.in/subjects/python-master-course
   Covers: basics, OOP, data structures, automation, Django, Flask, data science, ML

10. Java — https://wohotech.in/subjects/java-master-course
    Covers: core Java, OOP, collections, multithreading, JDBC, Spring Boot, DSA in Java

11. JavaScript — https://wohotech.in/subjects/javascript-complete-guide
    Covers: ES6+, DOM, async/await, closures, prototypes, Node.js, interview prep

12. SQL Complete Guide — https://wohotech.in/subjects/sql-complete-guide
    Covers: basic to advanced SQL, joins, subqueries, stored procedures, triggers, optimization

13. HTML — https://wohotech.in/subjects/html-complete-guide
    Covers: document structure, semantic elements, forms, tables, HTML5 APIs, accessibility

14. C Programming — https://wohotech.in/subjects/c-programming
    Covers: pointers, memory management, data structures in C, file handling

15. Web Development — https://wohotech.in/subjects/web-development
    Covers: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, Node.js, databases, REST APIs

16. Software Engineering — https://wohotech.in/subjects/software-engineering
    Covers: SDLC, Agile, UML, design patterns, testing

17. OOP — https://wohotech.in/subjects/object-oriented-programming

18. Information Security — https://wohotech.in/subjects/information-security
    Covers: cryptography, network security, ethical hacking, digital forensics

19. Cloud Computing — https://wohotech.in/subjects/cloud-computing
    Covers: AWS, Azure, GCP, containers, microservices, serverless

### 2. Coding Problems
URL: https://wohotech.in/problems
Description: 800+ coding practice problems with online judge. Categories include arrays, strings, linked lists, trees, graphs, dynamic programming, sorting, searching, and more.
Features: code editor, test cases, multiple language support, solutions

### 3. Free Online Tools (125+)
URL: https://wohotech.in/tools
All tools are free to use, no login required for most.

Categories and key tools:
- Academic: CGPA calculator, GPA calculator, marks percentage, grade calculator
- PDF tools: PDF merger, PDF to Word, PDF compressor, image to PDF, PDF to Excel
- Image tools: image compressor, image resizer, image color picker, merge images
- Programming: JSON formatter, SQL formatter, JS minifier, CSS minifier, base64 encoder
- SEO tools: meta tag generator, robots.txt generator, sitemap generator, keyword density
- Converters: unit converters (length, weight, temperature, volume, speed, energy)
- Generators: password generator, QR code generator, UUID generator, barcode generator
- Text tools: word counter, text summarizer, case converter, text reverser
- AI tools: AI paraphraser, text to speech, speech to text, OCR tool

### 4. WoHo AI Assistant
URL: https://wohotech.in/assistant
Capabilities:
- Conversational AI chat (study help, coding questions, explanations)
- Image generation
- PDF/document Q&A (upload file and ask questions)
- Translation and paraphrasing
- Code explanation and debugging help
- Study plans and exam preparation guidance

### 5. WoHoPlay (Social Video Platform)
URL: https://wohotech.in/wohoplay
A creator-focused platform for tech content creators in India. Features: video upload, reels, live streaming, posts, following, social feed.

### 6. Technicals (Tech News & Tutorials)

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: Is WoHoTech free?
A: Yes, all subject courses, most tools, and coding problems are completely free. Premium features (extra AI credits, advanced tools) require a subscription.

Q: What topics does WoHoTech cover?
A: Computer science fundamentals (DSA, OS, DBMS, networks, compiler design), programming languages (Python, Java, JavaScript, C, SQL, HTML), electronics (digital, analog, communication, signals), AI/ML, and web development.

Q: Is WoHoTech good for GATE preparation?
A: Yes. Courses on DSA, OS, DBMS, Computer Networks, and Compiler Design are structured for GATE exam preparation with theory, examples, and practice problems.

Q: Is WoHoTech suitable for campus placements?
A: Yes. The problems section covers LeetCode-style coding interview questions. Subject courses include dedicated interview preparation sections.

Q: What programming languages are supported in the code editor?
A: JavaScript, Python, Java, C, C++, and more.

## Content Quality Standards
- All subject content is written in English
- Minimum 1,000 words per topic page
- Includes definitions, examples, code snippets, comparison tables, complexity analysis
- Interview preparation section in each major subject
- Last updated dates displayed on content
